notes: Supplied determiners: the phrase's *the*s before `שָׁנָה`, `דָּבָר`, `פֶּה` and `רוּחַ` all go to those construct nouns under rule 29, since no article morpheme stands anywhere in those chains; `אַחַת` keeps only *first*, the determiner joining the noun it counts (rule 15).
The waw of `וַיַּעֲבֶר` takes the whole *so that* pair under rule 55; the alternative of heading it on *that* is noted in the unit.
*put it* is the only `added` material: rule 20 keeps a wholly supplied lexical verb and its supplied object out of the neighbouring `גַם`, `בְּ` and `מִכְתָּב` units.
`בְּפִי יִרְמְיָהוּ` is split rather than fused: the ASV spends a word on each morpheme, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet.
